title: 曼联承诺仍是商业巨头：不到三个月跌入降级区，垫底转播收入仍超1.1亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Back in September, Manchester United's executive co-chairman reassured investors that the storied UK football club remained a commercial powerhouse.
segments.zh: 去年九月，曼联执行联席主席向市场参与者保证，这家历史悠久的英国足球俱乐部仍是商业巨头。

segments.en: Less than three months later, the club is in the Premier League relegation zone for the first time in 40 years at this stage of the season, as its eighth permanent manager in
segments.zh: 不到三个月后，俱乐部在赛季这个阶段首次跌入英超降级区，这是40年来首次，而其13年来的第八位正式主教练正准备上任。

segments.en: 13 years prepares to take charge. Our UK business reporter David Hellier has co-written a piece for the terminal today entitled Can Anyone Fix Manchester United on and off the pitch and he joins us now for more?
segments.zh: 我们的英国商业记者大卫·赫利尔今天在终端上合写了一篇题为《有人能在场上和场下修复曼联吗》的文章，他现在加入我们了解更多。

segments.en: David, just how big are the sporting and business issues at Manchester United today?
segments.zh: 大卫，今天曼联在体育和商业上的问题到底有多大？

segments.en: I mean, as we've explained, they've got huge issues on both fronts.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，正如我们解释的，他们在这两方面都有巨大的问题。

segments.en: They've on the sporting side, they are as we say in the relegations and just like Tottenham were last year, relegation in the English Premier League is very significant financially
segments.zh: 在体育方面，他们正如我们所说处于降级区，就像去年热刺一样，英超降级在财务和体育上都非常重大。

segments.en: and sporting-wise. The bottom club in the Premier League earns more than 110 million from
segments.zh: 英超垫底俱乐部从转播收入中获利超过1.1亿，

segments.en: broadcast revenue, which goes down significantly if you get relegated to the lower tier, despite getting kind of parachute payments to come to ease this process.
segments.zh: 如果降级到低级别联赛，尽管有降落伞付款来缓解这一过程，收入仍会大幅下降。
